banner.heading: We value your privacy
banner.body: We use cookies to run Voltessa securely and, with your consent, to understand how the platform is used. You can change your choice at any time from “Cookie Settings” in the footer.

modal.title: Cookie Preferences
modal.description: Strictly necessary cookies are always on because Voltessa can't function without them. You choose everything else.

necessary.title: Strictly Necessary
necessary.description: Required for sign-in, security, and core functionality.

functional.title: Functional
functional.description: Enables optional features, such as our Calendly scheduling widget.

analytics.title: Analytics & Performance
analytics.description: Would help us understand how Voltessa is used, so we can improve it. Not currently in use — no analytics cookies are set today.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Would support advertising measurement. Not currently in use — no marketing cookies are set today.

calendlyGate.title: Functional cookies required
calendlyGate.description: Scheduling a call uses Calendly, a third-party widget that sets its own cookies. Enable Functional cookies in Cookie Settings to continue.
